task_functions.TASK-04B: 坡道结构化适配、时间映射、writer 和证据引用

task_functions.TASK-06: 完整结果使用/发布恢复聚合验收
task_functions.TASK-06A: 区间/结果仓储、验证协议、Bag 检索/血缘数据层
task_functions.TASK-06B: 正式回报 API、原子发布、幂等登记、换版/对账（R2 首审 REWORK）
task_functions.TASK-07: 统一界面、人工纠错/下架、预览（07A/07B DONE，07C 预览 DEFERRED 不自动激活）
task_functions.TASK-09: 坡道真包、视觉能力、时间与小样本内容核验
task_functions.TASK-10: 目录→坡道切片→数据库→API 获取真实工程闭环
task_functions.TASK-12: 其他四类场景逐类接入与质量验收
task_functions.TASK-13: 插盘上传工具接入服务
task_functions.TASK-14: 分布统计接口和可视化
task_functions.TASK-15: 完整容量基线、必要旧表改造、冷热归档/恢复
task_functions.TASK-12S-D2: 真实质量/血缘/批次验收

client_model_wait.limitations: Client elapsed time includes request preparation, network, SDK retries/backoff, server queue and inference; TTFB also includes network/prefill. Neither value is pure server queue time. Open or absent requests are not idle.
client_model_wait.coverage: Recorded request occupancy only. Its complement can contain tools or no API request; it does not by itself prove missing data or idle.
client_model_wait.missing_boundary_note: Legacy logs recover completed calls within retained log files only; errors/inflight calls without completion lines and rotated-away logs cannot be reconstructed exactly. No timing evidence for remaining time; it can contain tools, reasoning orchestration or idle.

role_task_dispatch.limitations: scheduled→claimed is scheduler lateness; claimed→started is role task dispatch waiting. Execution span includes scripts/models/tools/delivery. No queued_at or server queue boundary is present.

unmeasurable.pure_server_queue: Needs server-side per-request accepted/dequeued/inference events; client latency or TTFB cannot isolate it.
unmeasurable.pure_development_labor: Needs explicit development/tool activity boundaries; task status minus API time is insufficient.
